liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Space** (3 reviews): Brent added flowing sustained keyboard lines reminiscent of earlier Pigpen era; Jerry delivered solid soloing instead of his usual tired squeaking sounds [5][11][12]
- **The Other One** (2 reviews): Highlight included creative jam between Wharf Rat and The Other One; Transition from Wharf Rat to The Other One lacked obvious clues [9][10]
- **Deal** (1 review): First set wrapped with same energy as opening tandem on Deal [4]

## The recordings

- **gd80-05-31.aud.munder.11927.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 155 min; rated 3.6/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience tape sounds like it was recorded from under the stage [8]
- **gd1980-05-31.set2.sbd.miller.91763.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 13 songs; 92 min; rated 4.57/5 by 7 [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard recording is described as having a nice crisp sound quality [6]

## Around the show

- Band appeared ready to have fun after previous night's Milwaukee hassle [4]
- Listener snuck in PBR cans; Minneapolis Reader article hoped Jerry avoided Ship [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd80-05-31.aud.munder.11927.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [1]. Also: Audio path: AUD to MC to DAT to CD; seeded by Willy [1]
- **gd1980-05-31.set2.sbd.miller.91763.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Reel -> Dat (48k) D [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1980-05-31 Sat Metropolitan Sports Center, Bloomington, MN](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1269018982555/grateful-dead-1980-05-31-sat) [16]
